scenes.purpose: Show one planning task and the choice of provider, model and reasoning level.
scenes.script: Open a synthetic task packet. Voice: ‘Which eligible model and reasoning level can do this work without overprovisioning it?’

scenes.purpose: Explain the three answer types and why there is no generated explanation.
scenes.script: Show the question map. Voice: ‘We ask for lane fit, task clarity and complexity. Gemini returns probabilities and scores; code decides whether a recommendation is allowed.’
scenes.source: Labelled card derived from the committed question map

scenes.purpose: Compare the two routing methods on the same task and lane snapshot.
scenes.script: Run the rule baseline and Gemini adviser on the same packet. Narrate the observed recommendations or abstentions and distinguish any projected budget effect from actual usage.
scenes.source: Actual CLI output from the selected paired run

scenes.purpose: Show where the CLI refuses to suggest a route.
scenes.script: Show a blocked or reviewed task. Voice: ‘No score authorizes a provider or charges a budget. This tool can recommend a lane, or ask for review. It cannot launch an agent.’
scenes.source: Actual CLI output with no private identifiers

scenes.purpose: Show measured counts and the principal limitation.
scenes.script: Read paired gains, losses and coverage. Label downstream cost as a projection and show actual classifier usage and round-trip times separately.
scenes.source: Labelled results card generated from the published evidence revision

scenes.purpose: Give the viewer a reproducible next action.
scenes.script: Show the exact public revision and experiment commands. Voice: ‘The task fixtures, rule baseline and decision questions are in the repo. Run the comparison with your own synthetic tasks.’
